q1_issues.issue: (Name bush_administration "Bush administration") folds the lowercase common noun into both the symbol and the name string; the name is exactly the capitalized run, so this should be (Name bush "Bush") with the kind stated separately.
(Member bush_administration administration) carries the same fused symbol, so the kind atom types a name that includes its own kind word.

The bare-plural generic object "soldiers" is given a group witness (GroupOf sk_soldier_1 soldier); the bare class symbol is reserved for exactly this non-specific/generic object, so (Theme sk_glorify_1 soldier) is the licensed form.
(Past sk_put_1) puts tense on the non-finite gerund "putting", which marks no tense of its own — a non-finite embedded eventuality takes no status atom unless its own grammar supplies one.

q2_gaps: "but not" coordinating sub-clausal constituents ("glorifies soldiers but not the Bush administration") — the adversative connective rule needs two reified clauses as endpoints, and there are none here, so the contrast goes unrecorded

an object-predicative small clause ("calling troops the ... instrument of a blunt policy") — the naming/predicating complement of call/consider/elect is not addressed except in the impersonal-passive "is considered to be P" form
notes: The negation shape is right — one strength-0 conjunction for the un-glorified administration with the ground-"for" oblique inside it, and the presupposed putting asserted outside. Predicating instrument/bright/sharp of the group symbol is defensible here because the metaphor is collective (one singular instrument).
